## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the red block with the left arm, hand it to the right arm, and put it on the blue pad.

Task description: The target is the upright red rectangular block on the left; the destination is the blue square mat on the right. The left arm must grasp and hand it to the right arm, which then places it on the blue mat.

Success criteria: After the left-to-right handoff, the red cuboid's originally downward-facing end center must be near the blue mat's top center and close to surface height. The right gripper must be open and release it.

## Execution tips

- The left gripper can grasp opposite sides of the long block around its lower-middle section, away from the base and edges. Set the opening slightly wider than the grasp section and leave room for the right gripper to take over at the upper half.
- During the handoff, offset the grippers along the block body. Confirm the right fingers actually enclose opposite faces and hold securely before releasing the left gripper, to avoid losing support and dropping the block.
- Perform the handoff or reorientation in an open area away from the central beverage bottle, leaving room for both ends of the long block to rotate. Avoid brushing the bottle or fries box in front of the blue mat.
- Keep the original lower end facing the mat during placement. Reduce the lowering step size near the mat and release the right gripper only after the mat supports the long block, reducing the chance of tipping or landing on its edge.
